lines: (Rubs her eyes, smiling) He poured his own tea this morning. Hasn't done that in three years.
Come back before you go to the tower. I'll keep a pot warm.
Don't be afraid. The lesson that isn't on your company sheet: the master's guard is hard — run your fist into it until it breaks.
Techniques break his guard faster than plain attacks. He won't ask which company sent you.
